relations.evidence: śrīkāṃta upādhyābhājuyā pustaka jura || ṛṣitaṃ śrīśivanārāyaṇamiśraraḥ

date.as_written: saṃvat 875 naṣṭajyeṣṭaśuklayā, daśami, utraphāguṇīnakṣatra, variyānajoge, budhavāraśare

purpose: Copy made for (belongs to) Śrīkānta Upādhyāya Bhāju; preceded by the stock scribal apology verse (yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā ... mama doṣo na dīyate).
notes: "ṛṣitaṃ" is a corruption of "likhitaṃ". "śivanārāyaṇamiśraraḥ" = Śivanārāyaṇa Miśra (Newari -ra- ending); catalogue gives the full form Śivanārāyaṇamiśra, so miśra is treated as a caste/surname title. In "śrīkāṃta" the śrī is part of the personal name Śrīkānta (a Viṣṇu name), not an honorific, so retained. "upādhyābhājuyā" = upādhyāya + bhāju + Newari genitive -yā; "pustaka jura" = 'it is the book of'. "naṣṭa" qualifying Jyeṣṭha is unclear (possibly an intercalary/irregular month marker); kept as written. Date agrees with the catalogue. "thva kuhnu śaṃpuna yāṅā juraḥ" = 'on this day (the copy) was completed' (Newari). The following "(Bṛhaspatiṭīkā:)" is the cataloguer's heading for a second text, not part of this colophon.
